versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Work Productivity Tavily Web Workflow Helper skill.

- Delivers tailored, practical workflows and checklists for users seeking Tavily-style web search and productivity solutions.
- Focuses on helping users fix bugs, improve setup safety, and enhance reliability for similar workflows.
- Validated demand with strong support (12 online signals across 3 families); designed for broad agent and author needs.
- Ensures outputs are actionable, local-hardware friendly, and come with clear success criteria and validation steps.
